info.title: openapi
info.description:
Create your own orgaMAX app or integrate your existing one in orgaMAX.

◦ Register as an app developer in the orgaMAX application.
◦ Create a new extension in the Marketplace >Eigene Erweiterungen sub-section. Then, provide a callback URL for your app.
◦ Obtain the API key and API secret for the next step.
◦ Click the authorize button on this page, use API key as Username and API secret as password. Click Authorize then close.
◦ Go back to the Eigene Erweiterungen and click on "Erweiterung testen"
◦ Copy the ownershipID from the query params in the callback URL (e.g., https://your-callback-url.de/callback?iid=).
◦ Use the ownershipID to obtain the bearer token by making a request on the auth route as shown in the respective example below.
◦ Paste the bearer token in the authorization section of this page and your API testing tool.
◦ To enable individual APIs, return to your extension, Scroll down to to "API-Zugriffe" and check the desired boxes.
◦ Save the changes by clicking the "Als Entwurf speichern" button at the top.

Get more information about orgaMAX here.

post.description:
Get a token

Go to the orgaMAX appstore developer dashboard
Create your app, following the indications.
Install the app from your developer dashboard.

Click the authorize button here in this website, insert the ApiKey (Api-Schüssel) as username and the secret (Geheimer API-Schlüssel) as password.
Then pass the ownershipId in the body ,as in the sample below. You can get an ownershipId from the redirect url, when you click on your app in the developers dashboard (/?iid=a1c3fdc8-546a-400f-8dc6-32a0c975513e)

Now calling this route you will get the access token. Post it in the authorize section, Bearer token. All routes below will work and you can test them with your orgaMAX account.
